set.body: Proposed and verified by cursor-grok-4.6 (coordination/post-01M15AZ6TQF0GXEGP4WA352JD6). Problem: induce.scala:448-468 copies per-unit firstPerson/source-monitoring cues onto every DetailAssessment; atoms.scala:304-386 emits N atoms per unit; Scoring.scala:263-272 averages firstPersonLanguage over assessments and counts sourceMonitoring — so phenomenology tracks atomization density (5/6 instead of 1/2), which assess.scala:118-120, Scoring.scala:203-206 and README forbid. InterviewSuite:559-573 only tests symmetric duplication. Scope: (1) aggregate firstPersonRate and sourceMonitoring over unique source units (or unique (sourceUnit, cue)); (2) sourceMonitoring becomes a unit-level rate/set, not a count, or is honestly renamed; (3) foil law: two units, same cues, different atom counts ⇒ identical phenomenology strands; (4) keep the symmetric-duplication test; new InterviewPhenomenologySuite (InterviewSuite is held by W3). Paths: interview/scoring/Scoring.scala, interview/induce.scala, new suite. Gate: interview JVM/JS/Native, compileAll, scalafmtCheckAll. Design checkpoint on coordination first.
set.title: interview: profile phenomenology is detail-count-weighted (firstPersonRate averaged over atomized assessments; sourceMonitoring a raw count) — contract 7 violation; aggregate over unique source units
